checks.details: Correct sequential fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation and simulation passed; all 256 binary input combinations checked.

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; official correctness remains unevaluated.
No synthesis or board verification performed.

justified_changes.rtl: Initial implementation consists of two independent four-input NAND gates. No revisions.
justified_changes.testbench: Initial independent truth-table oracle checks every binary input combination with case-inequality mismatch detection and a bounded timeout. No revisions.

interface_cycle_contract: Original ten one-bit ports preserved; purely combinational, no clock, reset, or added latency.
numeric_width_decisions: All gate operands and outputs are one bit.
static_review: Two continuous assignments, no storage or multiple drivers.
